scope: Targeted notification/modern-rename/failed-renewal cleanup matrix; full Samba notification diagnostic remains failed and full SMB/NFS is not complete.

checks: SMB2.1/3.0/3.0.2/3.1.1 signed/encrypted asynchronous create/rename/delete, live ECHO, CANCEL and CLOSE cleanup
per-open first filter/watch-tree settings, FIFO completion and events buffered between requests
native host writes trigger recursive watches while nonrecursive watches ignore descendants
recursive watches stop observing moved-out subtrees and do not disclose queued outside names
SIZE filter ignores equal-length writes and reports actual growth
LAST_WRITE observes new-file writes even when native CREATE and WRITE are drained together
first per-open zero/short capacity persists, reopening restores capacity; NOTIFY_ENUM_DIR has no partial records; invalid-only filters stay pending and cancel cleanly
directory/list-access validation and persistent shared security descriptor changes generate SECURITY notifications
portable DOS attributes, creation-time and EA changes participate in native notification streams
initial CREATE metadata produces only ADDED; subsequent changes still produce MODIFIED
recursive descriptor exhaustion stays visibly overflowed across requests and releases all watches on close
delete-pending directories complete outstanding watches without waiting for last-handle deletion
TREE_DISCONNECT and LOGOFF finish pending notifications with NOTIFY_CLEANUP before releasing keys
policy revocation closes native watches and completes outstanding requests without retaining old authority
32 file/directory and full/metadata-only parent combinations enforce destination WRITE sharing; parent DELETE rights and child share mode do not add obsolete restrictions
moving files/directories out of an exclusively opened source directory checks the destination rather than rejecting the source parent
SMB2.1/3.0/3.0.2/3.1.1 repeated signed/encrypted NTLM renewal preserves session ID, keys, opens and byte-range locks
expired authority reports NETWORK_SESSION_EXPIRED and renews the same open after an intervening management login
wrong proof and different-user renewal fail, release exclusive handles and complete signed/encrypted watches with NOTIFY_CLEANUP
fresh valid credentials cannot renew a revoked token or resurrect its exclusive open
LOGOFF during an incomplete renewal resets authentication state and permits a fresh encrypted session on the same transport
SESSION_SETUP for an unknown session does not abort another session's in-progress renewal or borrow its signing key
